items.title: Carl Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Atlanta, Georgia, January 4, 2013
items.q: Robert Glasper. A lot of the young kids are really into Glasper. Vijay Iyer. Lionel Loueke.

ctx.x: Who would the 17- and 18-year-olds be passionate about, in your experience?
Robert Glasper. A lot of the young kids are really into Glasper. Vijay Iyer. Lionel Loueke.
Wow. I guess I would have guessed, well it probably speaks to my age, but maybe even like the Michael Brecker generation.
